description: Lands of Lore II: Guardians of Destiny (Westwood 1997, via Proton)
long: Lands of Lore II: Guardians of Destiny is a first-person action role-playing game and sequel to The Throne of Chaos. Players control Luther, son of the sorceress Scotia, who is cursed with shape-shifting transformations he must master to break. The game mixes real-time melee and spellcasting combat with adventure-style puzzle solving across a 3D world with prerendered scenes.
